## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: Epic's own sprint attempts a RED-marker push to main and is blocked by the check (verifying SC4(a) sprint-fixture verification). The 5-task base graph leaves this self-test implicit; T6 makes it explicit.

## Implementation Notes

After T4 lands (ci.yml umbrella job in place) and is merged into the session branch via a sub-PR, this task:

1. Creates a SHORT-LIVED sub-branch off the session branch (e.g., `red-marker-fixture-test`).
2. On that sub-branch, edits `.test-index` to add an intentional RED-marker entry: `src/__fixture__.py: tests/test___fixture__.py [test_fixture_proves_blocker_works]` plus a placeholder failing test file at `tests/test___fixture__.py` (or equivalent) so the marker is meaningful.
3. Opens a sub-PR `red-marker-fixture-test \xe2\x86\x92 session/<epic>` — this fires the new umbrella job. Captures the CI output to confirm the merge-tree scan flagged `[test_fixture_proves_blocker_works]` and exited non-zero.
4. Records the captured CI failure URL/output as a comment on this task and on the parent story.
5. Reverts/cleans up: deletes the sub-branch, removes the fixture marker + placeholder test file. The session branch is restored to a clean state with NO RED markers before the epic's session\xe2\x86\x92main merge attempt.

This task produces no committed source change to the session branch beyond the in-and-out fixture cycle. The artifact is the captured CI-failure evidence (ticket comments).

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| (transient sub-branch fixture, reverted) | n/a | n/a | n/a |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI failure evidence captured (URL + scan output) and recorded on parent story
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 3e0e-e533-a130-4175 2>&1 | grep -qE 'SPRINT_FIXTURE_VERIFICATION|red-test-blocker.*fail'
- [ ] Fixture sub-branch is deleted; session branch has no leftover red-marker fixture content
  Verify: ! grep -q 'test_fixture_proves_blocker_works' .test-index
- [ ] Session branch is clean of fixture files
  Verify: ! test -f tests/test___fixture__.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
